maitri_chapter1_verse5.title: Maitri Chapter 1 Verse 5
maitri_chapter1_verse5.introduction: This verse belongs to Maitri, Chapter 1.
maitri_chapter1_verse5.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Maitri Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 5, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
maitri_chapter1_verse5.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
